newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra continues probe into Colston claims.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra continues probe into Colston claims.

text.p: Australian Administrative Services Minister David Jull said on Thursday he had asked his department to continue probing allegations independent senator Mal Colston had misused his parliamentary privileges.
Jull told parliament an initial departmental report into allegations Colston had rorted his government car entitlements, which he received earlier on Thursday, was inconclusive.
"The report informs me that it is not able to conclude that Senator Colston has breached his entitlements," Jull said.
"There may be irregularities in the use of Com (Commonwealth) car in Canberra and his use of hire cars under his charter entitlement, but a more detailed examination is needed.
"In the meantime, Senator Colston must be accorded a presumption of innocence."

Colston is one of two independents the government has relied on to pass contentious legislation through parliament's upper house, where the ruling Liberal-National coalition is two seats short of a majority.
Colston is also facing a police investigation into allegations he misused an expense allowance.
